What’s new Agent adoption chart: Adds Copilot Chat and the VS Code Agents window, for nine features in total.

These users are active in Copilot but haven’t used a qualifying feature on at least two days in the 28-day period, so they don’t qualify for an adoption phase. copilot_feature_engagement.totals_by_feature : Adds chat and vscode_agent entries to enterprise and organization 28-day reports.
